text:
Maria - CSM: Hey team, heads-up on NovaAI migration. They're moving a large portion of traffic from APAC -> us-west due to a third-party peering change. They asked for a short-lived rate bump and allowlist for a set of migration IPs while they switch DNS. Renewal conversation in 2 weeks, so we want this smooth.
Alex - NetOps: ok, can you paste the CIDRs and the time window?
Maria - CSM: CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25. Window: 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-04 00:00 UTC (48h). They expect bursty traffic during that time. Org: org_0xNOVA, Account ID: acct_00987. Also asked for a failover route to our eu-fallback if us-west saturates.
June - Onboarding: I can run the migration checklist with them and watch connection patterns. Do we need to set a dedicated burst pool or just increase RLs on their account?
Sam - Product: From product side, suggest enabling automatic model-fallback to a smaller quantized variant if latency spikes. Keeps UX stable and reduces tokens. Need infra to confirm compatibility.
Alex - NetOps: We can add both: temp RL bump + an allowlist rule scoped to org_0xNOVA for those CIDRs. For burst capacity: we can tag their requests to use the shared-burst pool. I'll need a request body for the API change. Example config:
```
PATCH /v1/accounts/acct_00987/policies
{
  "temp_rate_limit": {"qps": 180, "dur": "48h"},
  "allowlist_ips": ["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.128/25"],
  "route_tag": "shared-burst"
}
```
Alex - NetOps: Note: shared-burst has capacity limits — if we see sustained >120k tps we auto-throttle. We'll set alerts.
Maria - CSM: NovaAI asked if we can exempt them from geo-blocking for the window (their edge gremlin caused redirects). Can we do that too?
Alex - NetOps: Yes, add geo-exempt flag scoped to acct_00987.
infra-bot: Policy draft created: policy_20260402_nova_mig. Pending manual approval from NetOps.
Alex - NetOps: Applied changes now. policy_id=policy_20260402_nova_mig. Temp RL 180 qps active, allowlist + geo-exempt set, route_tag=shared-burst. Alerts: bursting above 95% capacity -> page oncall.
June - Onboarding: I'll coordinate a smoke test at 00:15 UTC after DNS cutover and monitor for 30m. Sending zoom invite to NovaAI.
Maria - CSM: Amazing — thank you. I'll update NovaAI and add this to the renewal playbook notes (good signal for the renewal). Please keep thread updates if anything trips.
Sam - Product: Noted — I'll update fallback config to ensure responses use the quantized variant when latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive windows.
Maria - CSM: Closing loop: NovaAI confirmed migration success. We'll revoke allowlist and RL bump at 2026-04-04 00:05 UTC. :tada:
